text: みえない　ところ　でも　ホントは　なにか　おちてたり　する！

structure.jp: みえない　ところ　でも
structure.en: even in places you can't see

structure.jp: なにか　おちてたり　する！

patterns.name: 〜たり
patterns.explanation: たり plus する says this is the kind of thing that happens sometimes. おちてた is the short spoken form of おちていた. おちてたり　する = 'sometimes there's something lying there'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a place means 'even in' that place. みえない　ところ　でも = 'even in places you can't see'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. みえない　ところ = 'a place you can't see'.
